cars.summary: The Corrado G60 established a distinctive Volkswagen sports-coupe identity through its compact Karmann-built body, G-Lader supercharged engine and automatically extending rear spoiler. Its engineering and packaging went beyond a Golf trim or Scirocco rebadge, making the original G60 a landmark in Volkswagen’s sporting road-car history.

cars.generation: Manta B 400 original 2.4-litre road homologation coupe
cars.specification_market: Adam Opel AG Öffentlichkeitsarbeit, Pkw-Modellprogramm 1899–1995, June 1995, dedicated Manta 400 page 141; club-hosted facsimile, publisher page 2 checked. Original 1981–1984 road series, not rally Phase II/III. Its 106-kW/210-Nm L-Jetronic road tune and steel body are separate from Weber-fed competition output, Kevlar panels, wheel-arch kits and lowered race weight. Production and homologation-date disputes are not imported.
cars.summary: The Manta 400 is a significant rear-drive rally homologation road coupe and the successor to Opel’s Ascona 400. Its specialised injected 2.4-litre engine, five-speed transmission and dedicated chassis formed the road foundation for a successful competition lineage, while remaining distinct from the far more powerful rally-prepared cars.
